about: signals.promptugal.news's page views and reads, sent by assets/obs/obs.js into this site's own observability vault (daxpwzn4), made by signals.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 18 November 2026 with tools/obs-setup-signals.py, at the word of the person at signals.b@'s session ("yes, run the observability lane setup"; "yes, allow assets/obs/obs.json in the leak scan") and Dinis's guidance (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md). Public on purpose: each append token can only append to its lane, and the key can only encrypt. The drain is conductor.b@PrompTugal.dinis's (credentials sealed to its key).
what: This site counts page views and reading time, publicly, as promptugal.news does: the page, the referring site (host only), the time to the minute, the site version, a random id that ends with the tab, the screen size class, the browser's language and time zone, and the country, taken in the browser from its own time zone through a fixed table, with no network call (Dinis, 19 November 2026: no IP-based location). No third party is asked where a reader is; no region, city or position is kept. This site keeps no IP address, no cookie, no user-agent string and no fingerprint. Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control and Pause in the footer turn it off. What is counted: https://promptugal.news/newsroom/observability/index.html
